title: APPLIED CLINICAL WORKFLOWS
subtitle: Turning complex medical data into operational speed.

workflows.title: EHR & Patient History Summarization
workflows.description: The administrative burden on clinicians is unsustainable. Neryva securely processes decades of unstructured Electronic Health Records (EHR), physician notes, and lab results to generate chronological, strictly cited patient summaries in seconds.

workflows.title: Clinical Trial Protocol Analysis
workflows.description: Biotech and research firms rely on massive datasets. The Neryva Assistant parses dense clinical trial protocols, extracting inclusion/exclusion criteria, dosage requirements, and regulatory obligations with zero data leakage.

workflows.title: Medical Compliance & Revenue Cycle
workflows.description: Automate error-prone administrative tasks. Cross-reference medical billing codes against clinical documentation to ensure accuracy, and audit hospital operations against updated FDA and HIPAA mandates instantly.
